title: Birthday Cake Ice Cream (No Egg)
changes_from_base: A buttery cream cheese and vanilla mix gives a frosting flavour, and rainbow sprinkles replace the strawberries; no food colouring.
summary: A party ice cream that tastes of buttery vanilla cake icing, thanks to cream cheese, butter and plenty of vanilla, with rainbow sprinkles folded in at the end.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup
fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: check the label for plant-based colours and glaze

steps.title: Sweet base
steps.text: Warm the cream, milk, sugar, syrup and salt in the saucepan, stirring, until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Frosting flavour
steps.text: Beat the cream cheese, melted butter and vanilla in the small bowl until smooth, then whisk in a ladle of the warm base to loosen it. Whisk it all back into the pan; this gives the buttery, vanilla taste of cake icing.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Pour into the jug, cool and chill for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Sprinkle and freeze
steps.text: Fold in the sprinkles in the last few seconds only, so the colours stay in specks instead of bleeding, then freeze, covered, for at least 4 h.

tips: Choose sprinkles made with plant-based colours and glaze (check the label).
Add the sprinkles at the very end so the colours do not run.
Fold in some crumbled plain sponge cake for an extra cake layer.
storage: Keep covered with baking paper pressed on the surface in the freezer for up to 2 weeks. Soften for 10 min in the fridge before scooping.
